name: Saturday Night at Freddy's
summary:
After what went down at Freddy’s in the 90s, you refuse to return, but bills are tight, so you reluctantly accept the gig. Once inside, you find out something’s seriously wrong, unable to leave, locked inside with the recycled remains of a once pristine gang of animatronics, now old and stained with time. Will you survive 'til the cleanup crew arrives at 6? Or will you find yourself another victim of a horror story old as time…
In this FNAF-inspired horror-game, you must protect yourself from the animatronics of Freddy Fazbar's.
